## Abasheen Genie (CR 8)

**XP** 3,200  
 N Large outsider (air, extraplanar)  
 **Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +17  

**Defense**

 **AC** 21, touch 13, flat-footed 17 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +8 natural, –1 size)  
 **hp** 85 (10d10+30)  
 **Fort** +6; **Ref** +12; **Will** +13  
 **Defensive Abilities** air mastery  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft., fly 50 ft. (perfect)  
 **Melee** 2 slams +12 (2d6+3) or masterwork falchion +13/+8 (2d6+3/18–20)  
 **Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
 **Spell-like Abilities** (CL 10th):  

  At-will— command (DC 14), charm person (DC 14), plane shift (willing targets to elemental planes, Astral Plane, or Material Plane only)  
 1/day— *[geas/quest](../../magic/spells/geas-quest.md)*  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 16, **Dex** 17, **Con** 16, **Int** 20, **Wis** 18, **Cha** 17  
 **Base Atk** +10; **CMB** +14; **CMD** 28  
 **Feats** Combat Casting, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
 **Skills** Bluff +16, Diplomacy +16, Fly +22, Intimidate +16, Knowledge (arcana) +18, Knowledge (nobility) +18, Knowledge (planes) +18, Perception +17, Sense Motive +17, Spellcraft +15, Use Magic Device +13  
 **Languages** Abyssal, Auran, Common, Celestial, Infernal; telepathy 100 ft.  
 **Gear** masterwork falchion  

**Special Abilities**

 **Air Mastery (Ex)**  Airborne creatures take a –1 penalty on attack and damage rolls against an abasheen.  

  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any (Elemental Planes of Air)  
 **Organization** solitary, pair, or company (2–5)  
 **Treasure** standard
